title: ELSA Way toolbox entry
description: One tool in The ELSA Way toolbox. Each tool lives in its own file: toolbox/tools/<id>.yml.

id.description: Lowercase slug; must equal the file name without .yml.

full_name.description: Expanded name, if the short name is an acronym.

summary.description: One sentence, in your own words, saying what the tool helps you do.

description.description: One or two short paragraphs of Markdown, in your own words. Never copy text from another catalogue.

healthcare.description: Optional: how the tool applies to healthcare AI specifically, or known healthcare uses.

url.description: Canonical home page of the tool, maintained by its developers.

developers.description: People or organisations that created or maintain the tool.

format.description: Concrete form, e.g. 'Python package', 'Card game', 'Online questionnaire'.

future_ai.description: FUTURE-AI principles the tool mainly supports. Pick at most three.

audiences.description: Pathway audiences who would use the tool themselves.

duration.description: Typical time needed, e.g. '60-180 minutes' or 'ongoing'.

group_size.description: Number of participants, e.g. '3-8'. Omit for individual tools.

cost.description: Use on-request when the developers do not publish how to get the tool.

languages.description: ISO 639-1 codes of the languages the tool is available in.

maturity.description: established: widely used or formally adopted; emerging: new or limited evidence of use.

name.description: SPDX identifier where possible (e.g. 'MIT', 'CC-BY-SA-4.0'), otherwise a short description such as 'Free to use, all rights reserved'.

url.description: Where the licence or terms of use are stated.

rehost.description: true only if the licence lets The ELSA Way copy the tool's materials into this repository.

passages.description: Where the tool is recommended in the book. Each id must match a passage include in a chapter (see the toolbox contribution guide).

why.description: One sentence on how the tool helps with this specific passage.

see_also.description: Ids of related tools in this toolbox.

also_listed_in.description: Other catalogues that list this tool (links only).

last_reviewed.description: ISO date the facts were last checked.
